ValidationRule.description: Prevents a user from entering a Close Date that is greater than the Drive Date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ( CloseDate > Drive_Date__c && CloseDate != Date(1900,1,1) && Bypass_Validation_Rule__c == FALSE && Is_Template__c != True && TEXT(StageName) != 'Closed' )&& ( ISCHANGED(CloseDate) || ISCHANGED(Drive_Date__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Close Date cannot be after the Drive Date.
